results.evidence: Sitemap entries are deterministically derived from listSitemapRoutes(), canonicalized, de-duplicated and compared byte-for-identity at URL-set level against the indexable sitemap registry projection.
Every sitemap URL is checked against every configured crawler disallow rule; robots declares only the canonical sitemap; public/robots.txt is generated/validated against app/robots.ts SSOT.
No route marked noindex in the runtime SEO registry may appear in generated sitemap entries; conflict fixture is rejected.
lastModified is emitted only from factualLastModified, normalized at UTC midnight, must match the factual date exactly and may not be in the future.
[Eksik_veri] Private GSC cohort indexation data is unavailable; no cohort indexation percentage is fabricated.
Nine known attribution/click parameters plus unknown parameters are explicitly path-only canonical identities and are never sitemap identities.
[Eksik_veri] Cohort discovery/indexation SLO observation requires private measurement history not available to repository code.
